name: sv-pathfinder
description: SystemVerilog design navigation and RTL-tracing for VS Code. Seamlessly integrates with waveform viewer for post-simulation debug.

sv-pathfinder.sourcePathFrom.markdownDescription: Source-path prefix to rewrite when jumping to source. Useful when the design database was generated on another machine, so the paths it records don't exist locally: paths starting with this prefix have it swapped for `#sv-pathfinder.sourcePathTo#`. Takes effect only when `#sv-pathfinder.sourcePathTo#` is also set.

sv-pathfinder.sourcePathTo.markdownDescription: Local replacement for `#sv-pathfinder.sourcePathFrom#` — the prefix that makes the remapped path resolve on your machine. Takes effect only when `#sv-pathfinder.sourcePathFrom#` is also set.

sv-pathfinder.compiler.markdownDescription:
Compiler backend to parse and elaborate the `.f` files.
Prerequisites:
 - [slang-server](https://github.com/hudson-trading/slang-server): Requires the VS Code extension [slang-server: Verilog/SystemVerilog LSP](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=Hudson-River-Trading.vscode-slang) to be installed and properly configured.
 - [Surelog](https://github.com/chipsalliance/Surelog): Requires Surelog to be installed. Or specify surelog path in setting: `#sv-pathfinder.surelogPath#`.
markdownEnumDescriptions: [slang-server](https://github.com/hudson-trading/slang-server): A SystemVerilog language server based on the Slang library.
[Surelog](https://github.com/chipsalliance/Surelog): SystemVerilog 2017 Pre-processor, Parser, Elaborator, UHDM Compiler.

sv-pathfinder.surelogPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Surelog executable. If empty, 'surelog' will be resolved from your system PATH. This setting is only relevant when `#sv-pathfinder.compiler#` is set to 'Surelog'.

sv-pathfinder.showModulesView.markdownDescription: Show the Modules view (every module in the design; expand one to see its instances). Reload the window to apply.

sv-pathfinder.ossCadSuitePath.markdownDescription: Path to the [OSS CAD Suite](https://github.com/YosysHQ/oss-cad-suite-build) installation directory (the folder containing `bin/yosys`). OSS CAD Suite bundles Yosys with the [yosys-slang](https://github.com/povik/yosys-slang) SystemVerilog frontend, which the schematic feature uses as its primary backend. If empty, `yosys` is resolved from PATH; `yowasp-yosys` (`pip install yowasp-yosys`) is the zero-install fallback for simple designs.

sv-pathfinder.schematicAccentColor.markdownDescription: Accent color for the schematic viewer (child-instance fills and hover highlights). Any CSS color (e.g. `#4cc2ff`, `dodgerblue`). If empty, a theme-aware color is used (`--vscode-charts-blue`).

enumDescriptions: Tightest layout — smallest canvas, densest packing.
More room between blocks and around signal names.
Most generous spacing — easiest to read, largest canvas.
sv-pathfinder.schematicSpacing.markdownDescription: Layout density for the schematic: block spacing, the clearance around wire net-name labels, and box padding. Applies on the next render (reopen or refresh the schematic).

sv-pathfinder.schematicIncludeDirs.markdownDescription: Extra include directories for the schematic's Yosys elaboration (passed as `-I`/`-y`). Usually unnecessary — the filelist's own directory, each source file's directory, and any `+incdir+` in the `.f` are searched automatically. Add a directory here only when an `\`include` header or sibling module lives outside those (e.g. vendored headers a curated filelist references but doesn't include). The schematic error points here when an include/module can't be found.

sv-pathfinder.schematicShowDanglingNets.markdownDescription: Show declared-but-unconnected named nets (no driver and no load) as dashed, floating labels in the schematic. Off by default; normally such nets have nothing to draw and are omitted. Applies on the next render (reopen or refresh the schematic).

enumDescriptions: Elaborate the scope you open once, then render it and everything under it (step-into/expand, and stepping back up) from that single elaboration without re-elaborating. Only going ABOVE what you've opened re-elaborates. Best for small/medium designs.
Elaborate only the selected scope plus one level (direct children as boxes); stepping in or expanding re-elaborates the next level on demand. Cheaper to start on very large designs.
sv-pathfinder.schematicElaborationMode.markdownDescription: How much of the design the schematic elaborates at once (see the options below). Defaults to **shallow** — cheapest to start on large designs; switch to **full** on small/medium designs to step in and out without re-elaborating. Applies on the next render (reopen or refresh the schematic).

enumDescriptions: Bus values in hexadecimal (e.g. 0x1a). Bits that are x/z render as x/z digits.
Bus values in decimal. Values containing x/z fall back to binary (a 4-state value has no decimal).
Bus values in binary (the raw bit vector).
sv-pathfinder.valueAnnotationFormat.markdownDescription: Number format for bus (multi-bit) value annotations shown inline in the editor and in the hierarchy view. Single-bit signals are always shown as `0`/`1`/`x`/`z`.
